title: Drawing Money From a Keyturn Host Payout Account on Request
content:
Where a Keyturn Host Payout Account settles only when the host asks for the money, the host draws it in person on their own account, and what leaves the account is the drawable sum.

The sum a host may draw is not fixed before every reserve standing against a claim on the account carries the release entry that answering that claim calls for. While any such reserve on the account still stands without that release entry, the drawable sum is not yet a settled figure.

## The business effect

One draw sends money out of the account to the deposit account on file for it, as a standard bank transfer, and books a single new transfer entry out of the account. That entry carries the day of the call, the sum sent, the payout-transfer basis, the standard bank transfer method and a bank reference the host can quote, and it is reported in the statement month the call is made in. The balance the host may draw falls by the sum sent and the money is on its way to their deposit account.

## Invoking the draw

The tool `release_host_payout_draw_8e4fb8ab` is a tool of the host's own. It is unlocked and then handed over, and it is the customer themselves who runs it on their own account; the desk does not run it for them.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `payout_account_id` | The reference number of the host's own Keyturn Host Payout Account the money leaves | An identifier, as returned by the payout account lookup for this host |
| `draw_amount` | The sum sent out to the deposit account on file, in USD | A positive number rounded half to even to 2 decimal places; there is no empty value and no currency conversion, the account settling in USD throughout |

### Return

A single confirmation sentence in plain text. It carries the reference number of the new transfer entry, which is also the bank reference quotable against the deposit account, and the sum sent in USD to 2 decimal places. The presence of that transfer entry reference is what indicates the money has left the account.

## Points of judgement

**Where does the money go?** To the deposit account on file for the Keyturn Host Payout Account, as a standard bank transfer.

**Which statement month does the draw appear in?** The statement month the call is made in.
